remarks:
Nearly New. Exceptionally Versatile. Beautifully Positioned. Welcome to this inviting 5-bedroom, 2.5-bath home, built just three years ago and ideally situated in one of the area’s most desirable neighborhoods. From its beautiful curb appeal to its peaceful setting overlooking a creek and open space, this residence offers the perfect blend of modern comfort, style, and tranquility.

Inside, an inviting open-concept floor plan is enhanced by neutral finishes, abundant natural light, and a seamless flow designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The well-appointed kitchen features elegant quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and generous workspace, creating a stylish centerpiece for the home.

Upstairs, the versatile fifth bedroom offers exceptional flexibility as a private guest suite, home office, den, playroom, or creative space—adaptable to meet your lifestyle today and tomorrow. The full basement adds even more possibilities, featuring egress and a roughed-in bath, ready to be finished into additional living space, recreation area, home gym, or guest quarters.

Step outside and enjoy the serenity of a beautiful backyard that backs to a creek and open space, providing a rare sense of privacy and a picturesque natural backdrop. Set on a quiet street within a highly sought-after community, this exceptional home offers the lifestyle today's discerning buyer is looking for: modern, move-in ready, versatile, and beautifully connected to nature.

A rare opportunity to own a three-year-young home with room to grow and a setting you'll love coming home to.
